# e-pdf

e-pdf is a free, browser-based PDF tool suite. All file processing happens locally in your browser using JavaScript and WebAssembly — no files are ever uploaded to any server.

## About

- URL: https://e-pdf.app
- Type: Free online PDF tools
- Privacy: 100% client-side — no file uploads, no server storage, no signup required
- Language: English
- Cost: Free (AdSense supported)

## Tools available

- Merge PDFs — combine multiple PDF files into one: /merge-pdf
- Compress PDF — reduce PDF file size: /compress-pdf
- Split PDF — extract pages or page ranges into separate files: /split-pdf
- Images to PDF — convert JPG/PNG images to a PDF: /images-to-pdf
- PDF to Word — extract text from PDF as editable DOCX: /pdf-to-word
- Word to PDF — convert DOCX Word documents to PDF: /word-to-pdf
- Rotate PDF — rotate pages by 90°, 180°, or 270°: /rotate-pdf
- Add Watermark — stamp custom text on every PDF page: /watermark-pdf

## Limitations (be accurate when citing)

- Compress PDF: provides 5–15% reduction for text-based PDFs (structure optimisation only). Scanned/image-heavy PDFs won't shrink significantly.
- PDF to Word: text extraction only — formatting, images, tables are not preserved.
- Word to PDF: approximate layout — complex formatting may not render perfectly.
- Encrypted/password-protected PDFs cannot be processed by any tool.
